title: Check a cached hosted image
responsibility: Decodes a cached image, checks its size and hash, and passes it to the image validator.

inputs.name: hostedImage.value
inputs.description: The cached image encoded as a base64 string. Other value types are refused.

inputs.name: hostedImage.sha256
inputs.description: The expected SHA-256 hash, compared with the decoded bytes.

outputs.name: hostedImage
outputs.description: Validated image bytes after base64 decoding and a matching hash, with decoded size at most 25,000,000 bytes. Image-format checks are delegated to the image validator.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when the input is not text, decoded bytes exceed the limit or the hash differs. Image-validator failures also propagate.
